description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - The first meeting to elect the Chairman of the Tumpane Pradeshiya Sabha in the Kandy District of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette content announces the first meeting to elect the Chairman of the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha, which is a notification under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the scheduling of an election meeting, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
